[SWS_CM_90404]
⌈
For E2E-protected Events, in case of SOME/IP seri-
alization the E2E protection header shall be added to the message. If the protocol
specification of the respective network binding imposes restrictions on the placement
of the E2E protection header (e.g., [PRS_SOMEIP_00941] in case of SOME/IP net-
work binding), then these restrictions shall be honored.
⌋
